name: Titus Mission Pack
description: The Lieutenant Titus Mission Pack is a spin-off of Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team. Its parent game includes an expanded range of detailed miniatures, evocative terrain and unique rules. Fight tactical battles against opponents with your team of elite operatives, all set within the grim darkness of the far future.
composition:
One of each of the Space Marines.

1 Tyranid Warrior and 6 NPOs containing any combination of Hormagaunts and Termagants. Set them up within 3" of objective marker 1, with intervening terrain within their control range when viewed from the player drop zone.

abilities.name: Lethal Parry
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is retaliating, before resolving attack dice in Step 4 of the fight sequence, if you have any critical successes, you can immediately resolve one of them (before the NPO resolves any).

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.text:
Player operatives within 6" of this operative regain up to D3+3 lost wounds (roll separately for each), then remove all Mortal Wound tokens from those operatives.  
 This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.text:
Inflict D3+3 damage on each enemy operative within 3" of this operative (roll separately for each).  
This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle.

abilities.name: Lethal Parry
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is retaliating, before resolving attack dice in Step 4 of the fight sequence, if you have any critical successes, you can immediately resolve one of them (before the NPO resolves any).

abilities.name: Auspex Scan
abilities.text:
Until the end of this operative's next activation, whenever a player operative is shooting, fighting or retaliating, add 1 to the Critical Dmg stat of its weapons, and its successes equal to or greater than 5 are critical successes.
